title: Unit Event — On the Stage of Dazzling Light — Episode3 Fitting Into a Role

meta.Event: On the Stage of Dazzling Light
meta.Event Outline: Ever since his visit to Riley Dream Park, Tsukasa has felt a desire to improve even more as an actor. In the troupe's new ambassadorial show, he takes on a character unlike any he has before, with a personality entirely opposite his own.

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, let's delve further into this question of role compatibility.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My goal is to always assign roles in a way that takes advantage of an actor's strengths.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: An actor's strengths?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. Actors come in all shapes and sizes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For instance, some prefer to gradually get into character while others may try to imitate their foibles... Of course, there are prodigies who can immediately take full control of their characters, but let's set that aside for now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: From what I've seen, Tsukasa, I'd say you're someone who likes to gradually get into character. Seemingly the most popular archetype.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Gradually get into character...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In simpler terms, I believe you prefer to learn by doing since you and logical analyses of characters don't usually mix well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why I usually try to give you roles that are compatible with your personality, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, you've been deciding roles like this every time...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's amazing!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I am the director, aren't I?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I thought your goal was always to send Tsukasa flying, Rui♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Miku, wait.
Couldn't you have said that a little nicer?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry!
I was just trying to say how that's really cool!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I understand.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Anyway, to continue...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The protagonist, Thorpe, is a delicate creature who tends to dwell on things quite a bit... How would you all say he compares to Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They're total opposites!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah... Tsukasa usually just does whatever and isn't really bothered by much...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! I'm bothered by things just like anyone else!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But that's my point. This role involves a person with the opposite personality as you, Tsukasa. I have a feeling you'll struggle to fully get into character.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You excel at using your body to perform dynamic stunts. I can't say the same about expressing a character's internal struggle.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We don't have much time until our next show as ambassadors, so in terms of quality...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No...
I want to give it a try because I may struggle!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm sure you all remember the show we saw when we went to Riley Dream Park...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Through my eyes, it was an absolutely incredible spectacle. The way they balanced their dynamism with subtlety kept me on the edge of my seat...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It also led me to a painful realization! It showed me that I still don't have the acting ability required to captivate an audience the way they did!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I remember how Tsukasa studied every move they made as we watched...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's right. Just as you suggested that we take things one step at a time, I believe I've made some progress since then.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's why I want to take on a new kind of role!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I can't just keep playing the same types of characters over and over again.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There's an endless number of shows out there. I'm not about to let us give up on one because I may not be able to fit into a certain role!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: By growing as an actor, our shows will evolve while also being able to try our hand at more genres.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, please! Give me a chance!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As the director, I believe it's my duty to put on the most fun and interesting shows possible with this troupe...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: With that in mind, I cannot agree to do this show. However...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Tsukasa may be right...
It's just as important to help each actor grow if we do wish to put on fun shows.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which means, as a director, I probably shouldn't hinder our future star from reaching his full potential...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Does that mean we're going with this story?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, let's do this show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank you, Rui!
I promise to do this role justice!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. Let's do our best, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Bye, Miku♪ Bye, you guys♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Bye bye☆
Oh, Tsukasa, wait...!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Yes, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Good luck learning to play Thorpe!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I really loved the way you played the piano as him, so I'm sure you'll do great!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, that's the plan...!
As a future star, I vow to put on a good performance, so just you wait!
The next day
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's start practicing “A Pianist Named Thorpe”!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Is it me or does he sound louder than usual today?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: He's a motivated mammoth today!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, let's begin with a read-through. Some parts are going to be tricky, so let's go slow and steady with this one.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
“Let's start the audition.
First up, Thorpe. Show us what you got.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thorpe tries to play but his nerves get the better of him.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
“Thank you...
Alright, next.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Oh...
Based on that reaction... I failed again...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Why does this keep happening to me...? I always practice so much but can never execute when it matters most...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “No... I just have to keep trying until I get used to it! I have to learn to play in front of others...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “I need to practice... Oh wow...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“The stars look so beautiful tonight.
That must be Antares...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (No, I'm still not getting the star scene right...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (How am I supposed to feel here...?)
